content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid in cash at the Tahsildar Office Murud at the time of submitting the application. An additional Rs. 50/- form fee is charged in cash. The application fee is non-refundable and non-transferable.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process and Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises a 100-marks written examination followed by document verification and a medical examination conducted by the Civil Surgeon, Raigad-Murud. The written examination consists of objective multiple-choice questions totaling 100 marks. Each correct answer carries 1 mark, and there is no negative marking for incorrect answers.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Murud Raigad District Revenue Servant (Kotwal)
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application form format from the Tahsildar Office Murud by paying a cash fee of Rs. 50/-. Fill out the application form completely in your own handwriting in the prescribed format. Affix your recent passport-size color photograph in the designated space on the form and self-attest it, and provide additional color photographs. Attach self-attested or self-signed copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, school leaving certificate, domicile certificate, caste certificate, and identity proof. Submit the completed application form along with the required application fee in cash (Rs. 500/- for open category or Rs. 300/- for backward class candidates) by hand in person at Tahsildar Office Murud before the last date.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The Revenue Servant (Kotwal) appointment is strictly on a temporary basis, and the post is unclassified where holders are subject to specific service rules without regular pay scales or retirement benefits.

faq.question: Q2. Who gets an age or fee relaxation, and how much is it?
faq.answer: The notification specifies an application fee of Rs. 300/- for backward class candidates compared to Rs. 500/- for open category candidates. However, no age relaxation is permitted for this post.

faq.question: Q3. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who are not permanent residents of Murud taluka cannot apply, as residency in Murud taluka is a mandatory eligibility requirement.

faq.question: Q4. Which documents must be sent or brought along with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach standard documents including 4th standard passing certificate or school leaving certificate, Murud taluka domicile certificate, Maharashtra state age/domicile certificate, self-attested identity proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, or PAN card), and valid caste or non-creamy layer certificates where applicable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form in person at Tahsildar Office Murud is 17 October 2026 during office hours, excluding public holidays.
